system.description:
You can fill the hearts of your subjects with wild, violent emotion that drowns their minds in howling fervor. You can opt to be the object of this emotion or leave it unfocused, but cannot designate someone else as the recipient. Since this power can only inflame overwhelming feelings, not deaden them, the results are invariably stimulating.

You must first communicate with the victims in some manner, even a shared glance. Expend one Social Trait for each person you wish to affect (you may affect those closest to you, single out certain people, or choose just one). Perform a mass Social Challenge upon your victims; those who lose are overwhelmed by the emotion you select for the remainder of the scene.

Common emotions include Love (subjects are madly in love — similar to the blood oath with romantic overtones, redirected to someone else if not directed at you), Fear (Cainites suffer Rötschreck; mortals suffer overwhelming terror, as Dread Gaze), and Rage (subjects feel the urge to strike out at whatever irks them, or at you if you choose — Cainites are subject to frenzy as if humiliated, mortals must make Self-Control Tests, difficulty five Traits, or begin an all-out attack).
